The plate is roughly 26 cm across and spans about 350 px in the photo, so about 13 px per cm. The apple is about 125 px wide, which makes it roughly 9 cm in diameter. That is a medium-to-large apple. Its volume is about 4/3·π·4.5³, or roughly 380 cm³. Apples are less dense than that figure implies, so I estimate about 210 g. At about 52 kcal per 100 g, that fits an apple.
